discovered_out_of_scope_risks: GovernanceRuntime.evidence never populated — agent_loop.py:189 constructs GovernanceRuntime(config=config) without evidence. Must be wired with GovernanceDecisionEvidence(store=receipt_store).

GovernanceRuntime not wired into RuntimeToolExecutionRunner — uses separate ToolRuntimePolicy with hardcoded denial. Must pass permission_decision callback that delegates to GovernanceRuntime.should_execute_tool().

LocalActionEnvelopeGate in tool_runtime.py:449-454 calls require_signed_envelope() without public_key_provider — always blocks MUTATION_EXECUTION. Must either pass a key provider or set local_action_envelope_required=False until envelope infrastructure is ready.
CapabilityGate blocks on first launch (SETUP_REQUIRED) — no unlock() callers in Python codebase. Profile must be unlocked before any mutation capability gate can pass.
search_replace uses MUTATION_EXECUTION mode which hits all gates including LocalActionEnvelopeGate. Changing to MUTATION_PROPOSAL would skip gate 1.7 but keep other gates active.

AgentLoop and RuntimeToolExecutionRunner use separate policy construction patterns (individual callbacks vs ToolRuntimePolicy). A shared governance composer is needed to ensure both paths evaluate the same authorization semantics.
